entries.definition_vi: xem lại lịch trình hoặc thời gian biểu
examples: I check the schedule before I leave for the station.
She checked the schedule to see whether her meeting had moved.

entries.definition_vi: đến hoặc làm việc đúng giờ
examples: I try to be on time for every appointment.
The bus was on time, so we reached school before the bell.

entries.definition_vi: bị muộn so với kế hoạch
examples: I am running late for work because the train was cancelled.
When she runs late, she sends a message to let us know.

entries.definition_vi: bị kẹt xe trên đường
entries.pattern: get stuck in traffic + on the way to + place
examples: I got stuck in traffic on the way to the airport.
She leaves early so she does not get stuck in traffic.

entries.definition_vi: ăn vội một chút trước khi tiếp tục công việc
entries.pattern: grab a quick bite + before/between + activity
examples: I grab a quick bite between classes when I have little time.
We grabbed a quick bite before going to the cinema.
collocations: grab a quick bite at lunch

entries.definition_vi: bỏ bữa sáng
examples: I sometimes skip breakfast when I wake up late.
She never skips breakfast before a long day at work.

entries.definition_vi: dành riêng một khoảng thời gian cho việc gì
examples: I set aside time for exercise every morning.
They set aside time to plan the week together.

entries.definition_vi: tranh thủ chợp mắt giữa lịch trình bận rộn
entries.pattern: fit in a nap + before/between + activity
examples: I can fit in a nap before my evening shift.
She fitted in a short nap while the baby was asleep.

entries.definition_vi: đi ngủ để kết thúc ngày hôm đó
entries.pattern: turn in for the night + after + activity
examples: I turn in for the night after reading a few pages.
They turned in for the night as soon as they got home.
collocations: turn in early for the night

entries.definition_vi: lo liệu các việc nhà cần làm
entries.pattern: take care of chores + before/after + activity
examples: I take care of chores before I meet my friends.
They took care of chores together on Saturday morning.

entries.definition_vi: mang rác ra ngoài để đổ
entries.pattern: take out the rubbish + before/after + activity
examples: I take out the rubbish before leaving for work.
He forgot to take out the rubbish, so the kitchen smelled unpleasant.

entries.definition_vi: đi mua thực phẩm và đồ dùng thiết yếu
entries.pattern: do the grocery shopping + on + day
examples: I do the grocery shopping on Sunday afternoons.
She does the grocery shopping online when she is busy.

entries.definition_vi: chuẩn bị sẵn quần áo để mặc
examples: I lay out clothes for the next morning before going to bed.
She laid out her clothes for the interview the night before.

entries.definition_vi: chuẩn bị cho ngày hôm sau
entries.pattern: prepare for the next day + by + -ing
examples: I prepare for the next day by checking my calendar.
They prepare for the next day before they go to sleep.
collocations: prepare for the next day in advance

entries.definition_vi: viết nhật ký đều đặn
examples: I keep a diary to remember small moments from each day.
She kept a diary of her travels when she was younger.

entries.definition_vi: xem các tin nhắn của mình
examples: I check my messages after breakfast, not as soon as I wake up.
He checked his messages before leaving the office.

entries.definition_vi: bắt đầu một ngày sinh hoạt
examples: I start the day with a short walk.
She starts the day by reviewing her plans.

entries.definition_vi: kết thúc giờ làm việc
examples: I finish work at six and usually take the train home.
She finished work early because she had a dentist appointment.

entries.definition_vi: làm việc tại nhà thay vì đến nơi làm việc
examples: I work from home on Fridays and go to the office the rest of the week.
She worked from home while the roads were closed.

entries.definition_vi: lập danh sách các việc cần làm
entries.pattern: make a to-do list + for + period
examples: I make a to-do list before starting a busy day.
He made a to-do list for the weekend so he would not forget anything.

entries.definition_vi: gạch một việc đã hoàn thành khỏi danh sách
examples: I cross each task off a list when I finish it.
She crossed the final item off her list before lunch.
collocations: cross a task off a list

entries.definition_vi: xử lý những việc làm gián đoạn công việc
examples: I deal with interruptions by writing down where I stopped.
She finds it hard to deal with interruptions during online meetings.

entries.definition_vi: quay lại đúng tiến độ sau khi bị gián đoạn
entries.pattern: get back on track + after + setback
examples: I got back on track after taking a short break.
She made a new plan to get back on track with her studies.

entries.definition_vi: tuân theo lịch trình đã đặt ra
entries.pattern: stick to a schedule + during + period
examples: I stick to a schedule when I study for an exam.
It is difficult to stick to a schedule when meetings change at short notice.

entries.definition_vi: bị chậm hơn so với lịch trình dự kiến
entries.pattern: fall behind schedule + because of + reason
examples: I fell behind schedule because the bus was delayed.
The team may fall behind schedule if the equipment arrives late.
